$comment: Source-controlled ownership evidence for agent-surface assets that predate manifest tracking. Entries listed here are treated exactly like previous-manifest ownership: if they are not generated by the current install, the installer removes them; if they are still generated, the current generated output/config wins. Do not add action/reason/replaced_by fields.
files_$comment: File entries: { "target": "<target name or omit for all>", "output": "<install-root-relative path>" }. Optional source/version are informational only.
config_entries_$comment: Config entries: { "target": "<target name or omit for all>", "path": "<install-root-relative config path>", "format": "<merge route>", "ids": ["<owned entry id>"] }. The format identifies the merge/removal strategy; root keys are derived from it and are not duplicated here.
